canonical_claim.template: In 2025, Securitynational Mortgage Company denied {value} of its 2,761 decisioned FHA applications.

required_qualifiers.population: Securitynational Mortgage Company decisioned FHA applications (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate, unadjusted for applicant mix

does_not_establish: Securitynational Mortgage Company will deny any specific future application with 14.0% probability
Securitynational Mortgage Company is stricter or more lenient than another lender for a given applicant
Securitynational Mortgage Company discriminates or violates law
14.0% applies to Securitynational Mortgage Company's non-FHA lending
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
